patch.value: Allow safe transaction previews in managed-package workspaces with derived dependency links

A real pm item mutate --from intake.json --dry-run in this repository refuses transaction_preview_non_regular_file because installed extensions contain node_modules SDK links. The no-follow safety boundary and typed refusal are already delivered by pm-preview-path-refusal and pm-fa9olc; this is a distinct usability extension, not a claim those completed fixes are missing. Specify and implement a derived-package dependency exclusion or another safe preview source, without following links or ignoring authoritative tracker content.

A managed-package tracker can preview item-only mutations without following dependency symlinks; authoritative non-regular entries still refuse; source bytes remain untouched; SDK, CLI and MCP share the contract; isolated fixtures cover managed dependency links and hostile authoritative paths.
Normal package-managed tracker previews are useful and safe, with explicit classification of excluded derived dependencies and unchanged no-follow guarantees.
